deferred.operator: Stadtwerke Freudenstadt GmbH & Co. KG / Regioladen+
deferred.missing: The official sheet applies 0.10 EUR/min from minute 241 only from 07:00-21:00, capped at 12 EUR, and excludes the Marktplatz underground garage; Marktplatz also has its own 0.49 EUR/kWh AC rate. In addition, Stadtwerke Freudenstadt states that Regioladen+ operates the charging infrastructure, while legacy DE*FRE EVSE IDs remain observable. A prefix-wide rule would therefore lose station/time/operator-transition semantics.
deferred.unblock: Map the Marktplatz DE*FRE EVSE IDs and Regioladen+ ownership transition explicitly, and add validated time-window/cap support for the blocking fee.

evidence.stationEvidence: Current public station records confirm DE*FKB EVSEs and ad-hoc/direct payment; numerical prices vary by station evidence and are not published by the operator website as a reusable tariff.

deferred.reason: The official EGF page confirms that direct payment is available by scanning the EVSE QR code and that the applicable conditions/prices are shown only after scanning. No current operator price sheet or public endpoint exposing a numerical DE*FKB tariff was found. Aggregator values such as 0.49 EUR/kWh are discovery evidence only and cannot be promoted to a CPO tariff.
deferred.unblock: A reproducible public QR/direct-payment payload for DE*FKB, an official EGF tariff sheet/page, or a public DATEX/Mobilithek tariff field tied to DE*FKB EVSEs.

deferred.operator: Regioladen+ GmbH & Co. KG / former Stadtwerke Frankenthal infrastructure

evidence.stationEvidence: Legacy DE*SFT EVSEs remain visible publicly with ad-hoc capability; some third-party station pages show 0.51 EUR/kWh, but the current official operator page does not publish that numerical tariff.

deferred.reason: Stadtwerke Frankenthal officially states that its charging infrastructure was transferred to Regioladen+ on 2025-04-01. The current page exposes app-based cost information but no reusable numerical station tariff. Legacy DE*SFT identifiers therefore require an ownership/alias transition to Regioladen+ before any price can safely be attached, and third-party 0.51 EUR/kWh observations are not primary proof.
deferred.unblock: An official Regioladen+ price sheet or station-level public payload covering legacy DE*SFT EVSEs, plus explicit mapping of DE*SFT to the post-transfer Regioladen+ operator identity.

guardrails.note: DE*FKB and DE*SFT are set aside until new primary/station-level evidence appears. DE*FRE remains partial because exact energy prices are known, but station/time exceptions and the Regioladen+ ownership transition are not yet safe to flatten into a prefix-wide rule.
